Account background: long-time Redwood hosted API customer (since 2022). Started with embeddings for product search; expanded to chat-based support assistant in 2023. Signed 2024 hosted commitment $120k/year; Dedicated pilot ran Q4 2025 on 4x A100 nodes (burst to 8 during peak promos). Renewal window June 2026.

Renewal / expansion ask: customer is pushing for a Dedicated upgrade (steady-state 8x A100 equiv, burst plan to 16) to support holiday traffic plus stricter latency SLAs for personalization. They also want to adopt Redwood Optimize across three workloads (search, chat, rerank) to drive unit-cost down ~30% and enforce quality/regression checks. Technical constraints and goals: p95 chat latency target <200ms (in-region), throughput target 120 reqs/sec for personalization service at 256-token windows, top-1 rerank latency <75ms. Security & procurement notes: legal requested SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; security team requested simplified SAML SSO setup doc and data flow diagram. Customer quote from CTO (Anna Morales): "We need predictable ops during Black Friday — fallback path acceptable but must be automatic and audited."

Recent timeline: see recent_activities field for quick bullets.

Sales posture: strong exec sponsor (Head of Platform: D. Kline), procurement lead engaged. Opportunity to cross-sell Optimize and regional Dedicated as a bundle with a 12–24 month reserved commit. Recommend a blended pricing proposal with performance credits if we hit latency SLOs during peak test window.

Suggested next actions: prep SOW draft with dedicated sizing, include Optimize pilot scope (30-day optimization cycles), schedule technical validation run (3 days) in eu-west, deliver security pack (SOC2 evidence + SAML guide).
